Entry 3: Enemy Factions Part 3: Eshshu Babylonia
Eshshu Babylonia is the only country to survive the inital attack, when the isorropians and demons first invaded our solar system.
They claim to be the direct continuation of Babylonian Empire. 
They brought back the languages of Akkadian, Aramaic, and Sumerian from the dead, but Arabic is also commonly spoken there.
They believe in a unique neo-pagan religion called universalist paganism, that believes that all "gods" are all real 
and are either unique "gods" or are the same "gods" revealed to different people under different names and identities.
They are enemies of our Lord Yahweh our God, the only God. They hate and persecute Christians, Jews, and Muslims. 
Not just with a tax, but also with execution, murder, threats, violence, and slander.
The country's leader wasn't always a religious leader at the same time, but now, in this war, the country's leader is a dictator.
This dictator is just known as Abednego. No one knows where he came from.
All that is known is that he was a foreigner who came to the country, got hired at a low rank in the country's intellegence agency 
(The .E.B.A.U.M.E.R.),
made it a universalist pagan terrorist organization and an intellegence agency, and later became it's sole head leader.
He then became the sole head leader of his entire country.
Eshshu Babylonia sometimes is lead astray by isorropians who trick them into doing their bidding in diguise as their "deities."
This then causes the demons to unleash hell on the country until they do another sacrifice.
Needless to say, Eshshu Babylonia has an abusive relationship with their demonic allies and are our main earthly enemy.
